hook: Only for People Afraid of Losing

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Are you afraid <#0.2#> of losing someone you love?
voices.caption: Are you afraid of losing someone you love?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Shakespeare wrote: <#0.2#> to love that well which thou must leave ere long.
voices.caption: Shakespeare wrote: to love that well which thou must leave ere long.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Because you know you'll lose it, <#0.2#> you hold them tighter today, and say it today.
voices.caption: Because you know you'll lose it, you hold them tighter today, and say it today.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: And think of a wave. <#0.3#> A wave doesn't disappear. It returns to the sea.
voices.caption: And think of a wave. A wave doesn't disappear. It returns to the sea.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: The energy of love <#0.2#> doesn't disappear either.
voices.caption: The energy of love doesn't disappear either.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: So love more. <#0.3#> With an open hand.
voices.caption: So love more. With an open hand.
